name: The Vacant Crypt

detectability.signature: A hard-edged sphere of absolute sensor silence: no micrometeorite impacts, no background radiation, no returns of any kind

proximity: All passive sensors fall silent as the boundary nears
Starlight dims uniformly across the pocket's face
contact: Radio transmissions enter and produce no echo whatsoever
Propulsion wash vanishes meters behind the ship
prolonged_exposure: Crew describe mounting auditory silence and the feeling of being unobserved by the universe
Quantum clocks desynchronize from reference beacons by accumulating microseconds

behavior.cycle: 14-year orbital period around a white dwarf

phenomena: A circular patch of perfectly empty sky
Navigation instruments giving contradictory readings near the rim
Subspace interference patterns ringing the boundary
hazards: Total communications blackout within the boundary
known_incidents: The hermit vessel Quiet Argument moored inside for six years; her crew reported the most restful sleep of their lives
Insurance assessors refused coverage for cargo stored within the pocket, citing acts of absence
description: The Vacant Crypt is a sphere fourteen thousand kilometers across in which, by every measurement yet devised, nothing exists. It occludes the stars behind it with clean architectural precision, a round absence hanging beside a burnt-out white dwarf. No radiation enters, none leaves, and probes released across the boundary transmit nothing further.

The pocket follows a stately fourteen-year orbit around its dwarf star, and its boundary has not shifted by so much as a meter in recorded history. Instruments approaching the rim go quiet one sense at a time rather than failing at once. Vessels that graze the surface report a profound hush, as if the universe had briefly stepped out of the room.

Deep-survey teams logged the pocket during a gravity census of the dead system and dismissed it as equipment fault for the better part of a decade. Its antiquity, better than a billion years, suggests it predates every neighboring civilization. Philosophers and physicists alike prize it as a rare clean experiment: a place where the cosmos simply omitted a volume.

Anchorages avoid the system, finding its silence unsettling, which suits the occasional recluse and the research consortium keeping a tethered observatory on the rim. Whether anything can exist inside remains an open question. The pocket maintains its vacancy without comment.
